subject: Re: RFP bake-off — credits & trial structure
messages:
From: Jessica Park <jessica@redleafhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP bake-off — request for trial credits and timing

Hi Aditya,

Appreciate the call today. As discussed, RedLeaf Health is running an RFP-style bake-off next month comparing Redwood against two incumbents. Procurement asked me to confirm whether Redwood can provide a time-boxed evaluation with credits to cover a realistic workload (small POC plus benchmark run).

High-level ask: 60–90 day eval window, roughly 300k generation tokens plus 250k embedding calls for document search/semantic similarity for an initial cohort. Procurement also wants clarity on whether credits are refundable/conditional if we select another vendor.

We're trying to keep the RFP scoring neutral but credits will be part of our evaluation matrix. Can you confirm what Redwood can offer and any constraints (security, SLA for test traffic, extensions)? Also share any short MLP (mutual action plan) we can include in the RFP.

Thanks — happy to loop in procurement if you need a templated SOW or scope.

— Jessica
Senior Product Manager
RedLeaf Health

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Park <jessica@redleafhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off — request for trial credits and timing

Hi Jessica — thanks for the clear ask and for walking me through the RFP scoring yesterday. We can definitely support a time-boxed evaluation; I just need to confirm internal approvals and the most appropriate credit structure.

Quick questions to make sure we align:
- Is the 300k generation tokens the expected total for the full benchmark run or per week?
- Do you need embeddings to be available as a separate service endpoint for the test set, or will you run them as part of generation?
- Who will be the technical lead on your side for onboarding (so we schedule the CS kickoff)?

I looped in Soojin and Ben to propose an ops-friendly credit plan and cost estimate. Will get back with a proposed structure and any conditional extension language by end of day tomorrow.

Best,
Aditya
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: recommended credit anchoring and extension policy

Aditya / Ben — following up with a suggested structure based on typical bake-off needs and minimizing downside:

Proposal (anchor):
- Base evaluation credit: 150k generation tokens + 150k embedding calls (60 days).
- Performance bonus extension: additional 150k generation tokens + 100k embedding calls if RedLeaf proceeds to a paid POC within 30 days after eval and submits usage metrics showing >= 75% of benchmark tasks completed on Redwood.
- If competitor pricing materially undercuts us and RedLeaf chooses another provider, credits are consumed (non-refundable) but we'll offer a one-time courtesy extension of 30 days to validate migration data transfer.

Rationale: 1) Anchors the ask to a defensible starter allocation; 2) gives us leverage to convert to paid ARR for larger blocks; 3) aligns with our cost/approval thresholds so we don't overspend without signal.

Ops notes: Ben, this structure implies ~$8–10k in committed usage at our average blended token cost. Would need discretionary approval for the performance bonus band.

Soojin
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval request — RedLeaf RFP credits (deal RL-2026-047)

Vanessa — quick approval ask.

Background: RedLeaf Health (high-growth B2B clinical data company) invited Redwood into a competitive bake-off. They requested a 60–90 day eval to cover an expected ~300k gen / 250k embed workload. Soojin recommended the anchored structure below to protect our economics while making the offer compelling.

Recommended offer (preferred):
- Base: 150k generation tokens + 150k embedding calls (60 days)
- Contingent extension: +150k gen +100k embed if RedLeaf signs a paid POC within 30 days and usage metrics meet thresholds.
- Conditions: MSA signed or procurement OK to proceed; CS kickoff within 5 business days of acceptance; security questionnaire comms completed.

Estimated cost hit: ~$9,200 fully on the base allocation; contingent extension adds another ~$9k if triggered.

Why approve: 1) Win here likely converts to a multi-quarter POC and strong reference for healthcare vertical; 2) RedLeaf's product roadmap aligns with low-latency retrieval use cases where our batching/caching shows differentiated cost; 3) Competitive intensity means a neutral but credible credit offer improves our scoring.

Requested approval: discretionary authority to commit base credits and to pre-authorize the contingent extension (up to the amounts above) without requiring a second sign-off if procurement progress is satisfactory (i.e., MSA negotiation opens).

Attachments: RFP-scope.pdf (customer-sent), budget-breakdown.xlsx (internal rough estimate).

Thanks —
Aditya

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request — RedLeaf RFP credits (deal RL-2026-047)

Aditya — I approve the recommended structure with the following conditions:

1) APPROVED: base allocation 150k gen + 150k embed for 60 days.
2) CONDITIONAL APPROVAL: contingent extension (150k gen + 100k embed) pre-authorized but only triggered after:
   - MSA is executed or procurement issues a signed purchase intent; AND
   - CS kickoff completed and technical contact confirmed; AND
   - Security/compliance questionnaire status flagged as "in-progress" (no failing controls).
3) Require Legal to review any credit language in our standard SOW; do not share refundable/return language — credits are promotional, non-refundable.
4) Ben: please record the allocation in the credits ledger and tag deal RL-2026-047.

Keep the customer informed but do not include contingent extension in the public RFP doc; present as "performance-based extension available on conversion". We should also schedule an exec intro if the bake-off advances to final phase.

Vanessa
VP Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

- Contingent extension: up to an additional 150,000 generation tokens + 100,000 embedding calls if RedLeaf signs a paid POC within 30 days after the eval AND technical metrics meet the success criteria (we'll agree on basic pass/fail benchmark tasks during the CS kickoff).

Conditions:
- Credits are promotional and non-refundable.
- MSA or signed procurement intent required before we activate the contingent extension.
- CS kickoff within 5 business days of acceptance for onboarding and to agree on benchmark tasks.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm acceptance of the base offer and provide the technical contact for the CS kickoff.
2) I'll send a brief MLP and a DocuSign link for a one-page SOW that references the promotional credit allocation (not refunding).
